purpose: Freeze the same-date physical installed-capacity boundary used by the full Kerala2040 PyPSA base system. Renewable categories are location-based MNRE values; thermal is retained from official Kerala/CEA physical-capacity evidence. Allocation-based interstate shares are excluded from the physical fleet.

mnre_location_based_re.publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
mnre_location_based_re.title: State-wise (Location based) installed capacity of Renewable Power as on 31.03.2026
mnre_location_based_re.role: Same-date Kerala location-based renewable technology split

cea_kerala_transmission_ra.title: Resource Adequacy Plan for Transmission System of Kerala up to the year 2034-35
cea_kerala_transmission_ra.role: Kerala physical thermal/network planning crosscheck at the March-2026 boundary

cea_monthly_installed_capacity_march2026.title: Monthly Installed Capacity Report - March 2026
cea_monthly_installed_capacity_march2026.exclusion_rule: The state allocation tables contain Kerala shares in outside-state central/joint resources and therefore are not treated as Kerala location-based physical fleet.

demand_boundary_rule.reason: Avoid double-counting generation that is already reflected in observed net-grid demand until a compatible gross-demand and behind-the-meter generation reconstruction exists.

comparison_to_august_2026.rule: Keep the 31 August 2026 MNRE snapshot as a later overlay and compare only like-for-like categories.
